key_authorities.water_authority: Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board (HMWSSB) & TSIIC Bulk Water
key_authorities.single_window_portal: Telangana State Industrial Project Approval and Self-Certification System (TS-iPass)

eligible_capacity_thresholds.data_centre_unit: Minimum 5 MW IT load or INR 100 Crore capital investment
eligible_capacity_thresholds.data_centre_park: Minimum 20 MW IT load or 10 acres continuous land parcel

power_connectivity_covenants.grid_reliability_tier: Mandatory dual-HT feeder supply from two independent 220 kV / 132 kV grid substations for Tier-III and Tier-IV uptime compliance
power_connectivity_covenants.open_access_renewables: 100% open access permission granted for sourcing solar/wind renewable energy with waiver of wheeling charges for 5 years
power_connectivity_covenants.electricity_duty_exemption: 100% electricity duty exemption for 5 years from commercial operations date (COD)
power_connectivity_covenants.power_tariff_subsidy: Tariff rebate of INR 1.00 per unit on electricity consumed for first 3 years

water_and_environmental_rules.water_allocation: Assured bulk water supply at industrial tariffs through HMWSSB / TSIIC pipelines; minimum allocation 100 KLD for units up to 10 MW
water_and_environmental_rules.recycled_water_mandate: Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) required for campuses > 10 MW; air-cooled chillers or hybrid cooling recommended in non-perennial zones
water_and_environmental_rules.groundwater_abstraction: Strictly restricted in CGWB over-exploited and critical mandals (e.g. Serilingampally, Rajendranagar); groundwater extraction NOC from Central Ground Water Authority / State Ground Water Dept mandatory
water_and_environmental_rules.flood_screening: Buffer distance of at least 100 meters required from Musi river basin and designated lake Full Tank Level (FTL) boundaries

land_and_building_rules.zoning: Permitted in Industrial, Special Development (Kokapet), and Commercial zones; automatic land use conversion via TS-iPass
land_and_building_rules.floor_area_ratio: No upper FAR restriction in notified IT corridors subject to road width and fire safety clearances; standard FAR 3.0 to 4.0
land_and_building_rules.height_limits: Permissible up to 60 meters subject to Airports Authority of India (AAI) NOC
land_and_building_rules.stamp_duty_rebate: 100% reimbursement of stamp duty and transfer duty paid on purchase/lease of land or built-up space

State Disaster Response and Fire Services Fire Safety Recommendation & NOC
Gram Panchayat / HMDA / GHMC Building Plan Approval
Chief Electrical Inspectorate (CEIG) Substation & DG Set Energization Approval
TSPCB Consent for Operate (CFO) prior to commercial energization

governing_policy.policy_name: Maharashtra New IT and ITES Policy 2023
governing_policy.official_reference: Government Resolution No. ITP-2021/CR-170/Ind-2, dated 27 June 2023

key_authorities.nodal_agency: Directorate of Industries, Government of Maharashtra
key_authorities.transmission_utility: Maharashtra State Electricity Transmission Company Limited (MSETCL)
key_authorities.water_authority: MIDC Industrial Water Supply, CIDCO Water Supply, MCGM (Mumbai), PMC / PCMC (Pune)
key_authorities.single_window_portal: MAHITI Portal & MAITRI (Maharashtra Industry, Trade and Investment Facilitation Cell)

eligible_capacity_thresholds.data_centre_unit: Minimum 5 MW IT load or INR 100 Crore capital investment
eligible_capacity_thresholds.data_centre_park: Minimum 20 MW IT load or minimum 5 acres contiguous land
eligible_capacity_thresholds.essential_service_status: Declared an Essential Service under the Maharashtra Essential Services Maintenance Act (MESMA), ensuring 24x7x365 uninterrupted operations

power_connectivity_covenants.grid_reliability_tier: Mandatory dual-HT feeder connection from independent MSETCL / MSEDCL 220 kV or 110 kV receiving stations
power_connectivity_covenants.electricity_duty_exemption: 100% electricity duty exemption for 10 years in Zone A (Mumbai/Pune), 15 years in Zone B, and 20 years in Zone C/D
power_connectivity_covenants.power_tariff_subsidy: Tariff subsidy of INR 1.00 per unit for 3 years for new units outside Mumbai metropolitan zone
power_connectivity_covenants.green_energy_incentive: Permission for captive / group-captive renewable power generation and cross-subsidized open access

water_and_environmental_rules.water_allocation: Assured industrial pipeline quota by MIDC / CIDCO at notified industrial bulk water tariffs (approx. INR 25–45 per KL depending on zone)
water_and_environmental_rules.cooling_water_reuse: High-efficiency cooling systems with PUE <= 1.35 targeted; treated sewage / effluent reuse mandatory where available in TTC / Hinjawadi
water_and_environmental_rules.groundwater_abstraction: Strictly regulated under Maharashtra Ground Water (Development and Management) Act 2009; abstracting groundwater for cooling in notified over-exploited talukas (e.g. Haveli, Pune) is prohibited
water_and_environmental_rules.flood_screening: Mandatory terrain and drainage assessment; site must be outside the Blue Line (25-year flood mark) and Red Line (100-year flood mark) of local river basins (Mithi in Mumbai, Mula-Mutha in Pune)

land_and_building_rules.zoning: Permitted in Industrial, Commercial, and Information Technology zones under Unified Development Control and Promotion Regulations (UDCPR)
land_and_building_rules.floor_area_ratio: Additional FSI up to 3.0 in municipal areas and up to 4.0 in MIDC parks without charging premium
land_and_building_rules.height_and_floor_loading: Relaxation of floor-to-floor height up to 6.0 meters; structural floor loading capacity >= 1,200 kg/m² for server rooms
land_and_building_rules.stamp_duty_rebate: 100% stamp duty exemption in Zone B/C/D districts; 75% exemption in Zone A (Mumbai, Thane, Pune)

Directorate of Maharashtra Fire Services Fire Safety Recommendation Certificate
Local Planning Authority (MCGM / NMMC / PMC / PCMC / MIDC SPA) Building Approval
State Electrical Inspectorate Approval for Transformer, Switchgear and DGs
MPCB Consent to Operate (CTO) prior to data centre energization

key_authorities.nodal_agency: Department of Electronics, IT, BT and S&T / Karnataka Digital Economy Mission (KDEM)
key_authorities.water_authority: Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board (BWSSB) & KIADB Bulk Industrial Water
key_authorities.single_window_portal: Karnataka Single Window Clearance Portal (e-Udyami) & KDEM Fast-Track Desk

eligible_capacity_thresholds.data_centre_unit: Minimum 3 MW IT load or minimum capital investment of INR 50 Crore
eligible_capacity_thresholds.data_centre_park: Minimum 20 MW IT load and minimum area of 5 acres
eligible_capacity_thresholds.target_capacity: State target of 200+ MW capacity addition by 2027

power_connectivity_covenants.grid_reliability_tier: Dedicated 66 kV / 220 kV substation sanction from KPTCL with dual incoming lines from separate supply nodes
power_connectivity_covenants.electricity_duty_exemption: 100% electricity duty exemption for a period of 5 years from date of commissioning
power_connectivity_covenants.power_tariff_concession: Power tariff concession of INR 1.00 per unit for 3 years from commercial operation date
power_connectivity_covenants.renewable_power_banking: Banking of renewable energy permitted on an annual basis as per KERC regulations

water_and_environmental_rules.water_allocation: KIADB industrial supply or BWSSB bulk allocation; priority access to tertiary treated recycled water (TTRO)
water_and_environmental_rules.cooling_guidelines: Water Usage Effectiveness (WUE) <= 1.5 L/kWh targeted; mandates zero effluent discharge and internal recycling of cooling bleed water
water_and_environmental_rules.groundwater_abstraction: Strictly restricted under Karnataka Ground Water (Regulation and Control of Development and Management) Act 2011; extraction prohibited in Bengaluru Urban critical talukas
water_and_environmental_rules.flood_screening: Mandatory stormwater drain buffer of 30 meters from primary rajakkaluve (stormwater canals) and 50 meters from lake boundaries

land_and_building_rules.zoning: Permitted in Hi-Tech / Industrial, Commercial, and IT/BT zones in Master Plan 2031
land_and_building_rules.floor_area_ratio: Floor Area Ratio (FAR) up to 4.0 in KIADB industrial layouts without payment of compounding fees
land_and_building_rules.capital_subsidy: Capital subsidy of up to 10% on fixed capital investment outside Bengaluru Urban district (capped at INR 10 Crore)
land_and_building_rules.stamp_duty_rebate: 100% exemption on stamp duty and concessional registration charges of INR 1 per INR 1,000 on land transactions

key_authorities.distribution_utility: Tamil Nadu Generation and Distribution Corporation Limited (TANGEDCO)
key_authorities.water_authority: Chennai Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board (CMWSSB) & SIPCOT Water
key_authorities.single_window_portal: Guidance Tamil Nadu Single Window Portal (Biz Buddy)

eligible_capacity_thresholds.data_centre_unit: Minimum 3 MW IT load or minimum capital investment of INR 500 Crore
eligible_capacity_thresholds.data_centre_park: Minimum 20 MW IT load with integrated campus infrastructure
eligible_capacity_thresholds.connectivity_focus: Leverages 5+ direct submarine cable landing stations in Chennai (Bay of Bengal Gateway, SeaMeWe, BBG)

power_connectivity_covenants.grid_reliability_tier: Dual HT power supply from two separate 230 kV / 110 kV substations of TANTRANSCO; 100% backup transmission capacity guaranteed
power_connectivity_covenants.electricity_duty_exemption: 100% exemption on electricity duty for 5 years on power purchased from TANGEDCO or green energy generators
power_connectivity_covenants.green_power_open_access: Concessional cross-subsidy surcharge and wheeling charges for captive or open access solar and wind power plants in Tamil Nadu
power_connectivity_covenants.dual_feeder_support: Special tariff structure for redundant power lines and standby generation fuel reserves

water_and_environmental_rules.water_allocation: Priority allocation of tertiary treated reverse osmosis (TTRO) water from CMWSSB Koyambedu / Kodungaiyur plants (up to 45 MLD available)
water_and_environmental_rules.coastal_and_crz_screening: Strict Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ) clearance required for any cable landing or cooling water outfall within 500m of the coast
water_and_environmental_rules.groundwater_abstraction: Groundwater extraction heavily prohibited in Chennai metropolitan area and over-exploited coastal aquifers; CMWSSB water agreement mandatory
water_and_environmental_rules.flood_screening: Site must be evaluated against 2015 Chennai flood contour maps; mandatory minimum ground level raising (+1.5m above surrounding road level)

land_and_building_rules.zoning: Permitted in Industrial, IT Corridor, and Commercial zones under Tamil Nadu Combined Development and Building Rules (TNCDBR) 2019
land_and_building_rules.floor_area_ratio: Higher FSI permitted (up to 3.25 to 4.0 in designated IT expressways) with relaxed boundary setback requirements for technical buildings
land_and_building_rules.building_heights: Exemption from standard ceiling height restrictions, permitting server hall clear heights up to 6.5 meters
land_and_building_rules.stamp_duty_rebate: 100% stamp duty exemption in Category B & C districts; 50% exemption in Category A districts (Chennai, Kanchipuram, Chengalpattu, Tiruvallur)
